summary: Architectural blueprint and implementation plan for the App Cache Data Cleaner feature in Stop it. Details the dedicated CacheCleanerAutomationManager, AccessibilityService two-step navigation heuristics (Pixel 'Storage and cache' vs Samsung OneUI 'Storage', and 'Clear cache' button clicks), Usage Access (PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS) permission integration for reading real cache sizes, and UI integration of bin icons on Running and Whitelist app rows.
